sources.title: tactics.tools Set 18 item info (stats and effects)
sources.note: Page says 'Set 18' without a patch. Inferred 18.2: it has the 18.2 Bloodthirster values but not the 18.3 artifact changes (Collector 40% AD, Statikk Shiv 15 AP) nor the 18.4 Crownguard/Spirit Visage changes. Read by hand, numbers transcribed in tools/curate_item_stats.py.

sources.title: tactics.tools Set 18 augment info (tiers)
sources.note: 69 silver, 112 gold, 68 prismatic. Inferred pre-18.3: Upward Mobility shows 1 reroll (18.3 made it 2), Level Up! 6 XP (18.4 made it 10), Chosen of the Sun still gold (18.4 moved it to silver). Only tiers are used.

sources.title: Item tooltip screenshots sent by the owner (three Radiant items; all 21 Set 18 emblems)
sources.note: Where the screenshots were taken (game client or a site) is not yet confirmed. The emblem numbers predate 18.3 (Hunter 18% AD, Invoker 3 Mana Regen, Juggernaut 15 Mana, Brawler 2%) and 18.4 (Elderwood 35 resists), so they likely come from a site with old data; the note changes are applied on top.

sources.title: Owner's in-game check, patch 18.4b (screenshot and notes)
sources.note: Screenshot of the shop bar at level 7: odds 16% / 30% / 43% / 10% / 1%, XP 20/56, Buy XP 4 gold. Owner's notes from the game: level 8 odds 15/20/32/30/3, level 9 10/17/25/33/15, reroll 2 gold, Buy XP gives 4 XP, 2 XP every round, 7->8 56 XP, 8->9 and 9->10 68 XP.
